hint.tools: Which actions may run without confirmation.
hint.browser: Choose which browser the agent uses to open web pages.
hint.appearance: Language, theme, color mode and type size.

team.acceptHint: Accept this invitation to join the workspace.
team.accepted: Invitation accepted. The workspace is now selected.

tools.permissionNote: Tool permissions are confirmed per action in chat; enforcement happens on the backend.

desc.auto: Prefer your own browser through the extension, and fall back to the cloud browser when it isn't connected. Not available on phones.
desc.local: Always use Chrome on the cloud desktop — no extension needed; site logins live on the cloud desktop.
desc.remote: Use Chrome on your own computer through the extension, with your logins; keep the extension connected.

browser.fallbackHint: The extension isn't connected yet — the cloud browser will be used until it connects.

notifications.title: System notifications
notifications.description: Receive task results and requests only while locked, in the background, or offline. All foreground pages, temporary focus loss and brief connection loss stay quiet. Signing in on another phone moves notifications to it.

status.denied: Notifications are blocked in system settings

notifications.localBody: This notification checks display on this phone.
notifications.unavailable: The task linked to this notification is no longer available.
notifications.setupFailed: Notifications are not connected. Please retry.

result.local: Local test scheduled. Lock or background the app within 10 seconds and keep its process running. Staying in the foreground suppresses it.
result.accepted: The push service accepted the test. Check your system notifications.
result.failed: The test notification failed. Please retry.
result.cancelled: The app returned to the foreground, or your login or notification binding changed. The notification was cancelled.
result.unbound: This phone is not registered for notifications.
result.pending: Server test scheduled. Lock or background the app within 10 seconds. Staying in or returning to the foreground suppresses it.
